title: 机场值机与托运
goal: 能在值机柜台办理登机牌、选座位、托运行李，听懂关于行李和充电宝的提问。
tips: check in 有两个意思：办理值机（check in for a flight）和托运行李（check in a bag）。酒店入住也叫 check in。
充电宝、锂电池必须随身携带，不能托运。被问到时说 It's in my carry-on.
登机牌上的 Gate 是登机口，Boarding 是开始登机时间，Seat 是座位号。

exchanges.hear: Where are you flying to today?
May I see your passport, please?
Do you have any bags to check in?
Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
exchanges.hearZh: 您想要靠窗还是靠过道的座位？

exchanges.hear: Your bag is overweight. There's an extra charge.
exchanges.hearZh: 您的行李超重了，需要额外收费。
exchanges.reply: Can I take some things out?
exchanges.replyZh: 我能拿出来一些东西吗？

exchanges.hear: Are there any power banks or batteries in this bag?
exchanges.hearZh: 这个包里有充电宝或电池吗？
exchanges.reply: No, they're all in my carry-on.
exchanges.replyZh: 没有，都在我的随身行李里。

exchanges.hear: Did you pack this bag yourself?
exchanges.hearZh: 这个包是您自己打包的吗？

exchanges.hear: Boarding starts at nine fifteen at Gate thirty-two.
exchanges.hearZh: 九点十五分在32号登机口开始登机。
exchanges.reply: Gate thirty-two at nine fifteen. Thank you.

lines.en: Good morning. Where are you flying today?
May I see your passport, please?
Thank you. How many bags are you checking in?
lines.zh: 谢谢。您要托运几件行李？

lines.en: Please put it on the scale. Are there any power banks in it?
lines.zh: 请把它放到秤上。里面有充电宝吗？

lines.en: No. My power bank is in my backpack.
lines.zh: 没有。我的充电宝在双肩包里。

lines.en: OK. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
lines.zh: 好的。您想要靠窗还是靠过道？

lines.en: Here's your boarding pass. Boarding starts at ten thirty at Gate eighteen.
lines.zh: 这是您的登机牌。十点半在18号登机口开始登机。
